sprint: THE PROVENANCE SPRINT (V42): the Ship Gate checked the SHAPE and not the IDENTITY, so a stale header sailed through the one wall built to stop it. V41 emitted a pinsSha that was a PARENT'S (currentPins frozen at family-pins.json, V39 2c299b9e — never THIS sprint's), a batteryDelta describing the 1281-CURATED subset instead of the 1892-battery's +48 movement, and a D33 note that was V39's prose reproduced verbatim in a 'generated' field — each SHAPE-VALID and IDENTITY-WRONG, each sailing through Ship.gate() because it proved 'is it a 40-hex hash?' and never 'is it THIS SPRINT'S hash?'. The exact 'shape ≠ truth' lesson this arc was built on, recurring ONE LAYER UP — and STILL NO NEW LAW (a seventh sprint), because X-REACH(a) already reaches it: a check that cannot fail where it matters is not a check, and a hash never compared to its own source is a shape check wearing an identity check's clothes. So the Ship Gate graduates from SHAPE to IDENTITY-AND-FRESHNESS: the emitted pins-sha must equal sha256 of THIS sprint's own pins file (frozen at Phase 0); every generated claim is recomputed-this-run or explicitly tagged carried:{from,why,reverified} (re-verified against a recompute, never skipped); the batteryDelta reconciles the FULL battery across the sprint boundary. AND THEN, with the research in hand, the first data-provider stone in the moat: the REAL★ point-in-time capture engine — organon.sh capture grows from a marginal-value renderer (V41) into a real poller of rate-space yield (Aave getReserveData, Sky SSR, Ethena funding), block-pinned, re-derivable, content-hashed, provider-attributed, structurally walled away from the RETROSPECTIVE charts a falsifier may never deflate on. No new mass-path dependency (fetch + hand-encoded eth_call; deps stay 2), no daemon (a VERB, the Operator's own cadence), no valuation (rate-space only). The whole Operator gate D23–D86, D27 STILL FIRST (the SEVENTEENTH sprint).

noNewLaw.rule: SEVENTEEN laws stand; ZERO minted this sprint (the seventh running). Every V41 defect is an existing law UNDER-APPLIED. X-REACH(a): a check that cannot fail WHERE IT MATTERS is not a check — a pins-sha never compared to its own source file cannot fail on a stale value, so S143's shape check was an identity check's clothes. X-SHOWN(c): the sprint must end in ITS OWN hash — a header echoing a parent's pin does not. The constitution reaches all of it; the gate's application was shallow, and this sprint deepens it from shape to identity. The moat is not extended by a law; it is extended by a capture engine and a gate that cannot be fooled by last sprint's truth.

adversarialRecord_partA.A1_fatalRecursion: 'The identity gate is itself code that will be tested-not-applied — S169 will pass its unit test and the real emit will still carry a stale pin, exactly like S143 did.' THE FATAL RECURSION, the THIRD time this arc has faced it. It must be proven on the real emit path or the sprint is theatre. The positive control is an end-to-end transcript (the V40 RP-1 discipline, mandatory): seed the parent pin into the real pins-sha producer, run the REAL emit command, SHOW the refusal and that no build log was written. And S169 compares the emitted value to sha256 of the pins file ON DISK at emit time — not to a constant, not to a fixture. A gate that cannot fail on a stale pin is the exact defect; the control proves it CAN.
adversarialRecord_partA.A2_carriedIsLoophole: 'carried:{from,why} is a loophole — every stale field will be tagged carried and sail through, and now staleness is BLESSED.' Lands hard. A tag that excuses staleness is worse than no tag. So carried is legal ONLY when the underlying deviation's state is unchanged AND the carry is RE-VERIFIED: S170 asserts a carried field's value equals what a recompute WOULD produce — it re-runs the producer and checks the carried string matches. If a recompute would differ, carried is a lie and FAILS. A carried claim is a claim that was recomputed and found identical — not one that was skipped. The D33 note qualifies (D33 unchanged); a stale batteryDelta would NOT (the battery moved).
adversarialRecord_partA.A3_handEncodedIsBugFarm: 'The capture engine hand-encodes eth_call — a hand-rolled ABI encoder is a bug farm, and a wrong encoding silently captures GARBAGE into your provenance moat, worse than no moat.' THE SHARPEST ATTACK. A poisoned REAL★ archive is a catastrophe. So: the hand-encoded call is validated against a KNOWN-ANSWER at a pinned historical block (a committed fixture rawReturn decoded to a known rate, cross-checked CLOSE against DeFiLlama at the same timestamp — CLOSE, not identical, different methodologies). A capture whose raw decode is implausible (non-numeric, address/index mis-slice) FAILS and is NOT chained. The encoding is frozen once validated: a wall pins the exact selector for each function (S177). Garbage cannot enter the chain silently — it must pass a STRUCTURAL plausibility gate and match a pinned selector.
adversarialRecord_partA.A4_scopeCreepToDataPlatform: 'You are building a data-ingestion pipeline into a tool whose whole identity is 2 dependencies and no server. Scope creep toward a data platform.' A real drift risk; the boundary must be surgical. The capture engine is a VERB that reads over fetch and writes hash-chained JSONL — no new dep, no daemon, no server, no port. It is the SAME architecture as every existing capture (the governance screen, the oracle-staleness read already eth_call today). Deps 2, screens 3, no scheduler — all walled.
adversarialRecord_partA.A5_emptyArchiveForever: 'REAL★ captures start at zero and grow one-per-run. The Operator has never run anything. So the archive is empty forever, an elaborate poller for a series of length 0.' TRUE, the recurring truth — but it inverts under the pivot. The capture engine is the FIRST feature whose value COMPOUNDS with use and whose FIRST run produces something the tool never had: a REAL★ point of length 1. V41 made authoring a second manifest worth it; V42 makes running capture worth it — each run advances the false-fire count toward judgeable. The agent cannot run it for him (AGENT-tier, quarantined). realLineageCount 0 and ownCaptures 0 both render at the gate, honestly.
adversarialRecord_partA.A6_noLawForAPipeline: 'Seven sprints without a law, and now a whole capture subsystem governed by the existing laws? A data pipeline has failure modes the constitution never anticipated.' The laws answer: X-MOAT governs the tier (REAL★ vs RETROSPECTIVE vs REAL@ts); X-HONEST governs the UNJUDGEABLE floor (missing stays missing); X-RECKON governs the capture as an act (content-hashed at the append site); X-REACH(a) governs the plausibility gate (a capture that cannot fail its decode is not validated). Every failure mode maps to an existing law. If one appeared that did not — THAT would be the signal for law eighteen. It has not.

postImplementationRePins_partF.RP1_pinsFrozenAtPhase0: F-1 CRITICAL — the pins file on disk at EMIT time may not be the one the sprint was BUILT against. The pins file is frozen at Phase 0 and content-hashed into provenance-pins.json itself (the pinsSha field, a self-referential anchor computed once = sha256 of the content minus that field). S169 compares the emitted pins-sha to that Phase-0 anchor, and the self-consistency check (recompute === stored) asserts the pins file did not change after Phase 0. A pins file edited after Phase 0 REFUSES the log.
postImplementationRePins_partF.RP2_ownInputsNotTransitive: F-2 HIGH — carried re-verification recomputes ONLY the specific claim's own inputs, not transitively-coupled state. The D33 note is SPLIT: the SIGNABILITY claim (carried, unchanged) from any FALSE-FIRE reference (recomputed, changed this sprint by the REAL★ archive). A carried claim that transitively depends on state that moved this sprint is RECOMPUTED, not carried. A carry is honest only if every input to it is unchanged.
postImplementationRePins_partF.RP3_structuralNotEconomic: F-3 HIGH — the plausibility gate rejects ONLY structurally-impossible decodes (wrong ABI width, non-finite, address/index mis-slice), NOT economically-extreme values. A −42% funding rate is plausible and CAPTURED (it is real); a 1.7e308 word is a decode error and rejected. The gate tests the ENCODING, never the ECONOMICS. A seeded −42% funding capture MUST be CHAINED (the positive control).
postImplementationRePins_partF.RP4_deFiLlamaSmokeTest: F-4 MEDIUM-HIGH — the DeFiLlama cross-check is a plausibility sanity check ONLY (order-of-magnitude), never a correctness oracle. The REAL★ value's authority is its re-derivability at the pinned block, NOT its agreement with DeFiLlama. The log states: 'REAL★ is authoritative by re-derivation; DeFiLlama agreement is a smoke test, not a proof.' A REAL★ capture that disagrees with DeFiLlama is still REAL★ if it re-derives.
postImplementationRePins_partF.RP5_contractVersionPinned: F-5 MEDIUM-HIGH — the poller pins the implementation address and the exact struct layout per capture, and records the contract code-hash in the observation. A capture against a contract whose code hash differs from the pinned one FAILS. The re-derivability guarantee requires pinning not just the block but the contract version decoded — an upgrade is a new pinned target, disclosed, not a silent re-decode.
postImplementationRePins_partF.RP6_honestAtEveryLength: F-6 MEDIUM — the false-fire own-leg renders honestly at every length: at 0, UNJUDGEABLE (0 captures); at 3, UNJUDGEABLE (3 of 180 — 177 to go); never a number that pretends 3 captures is a judgeable series. The gate prints ownCaptures:0 today, truthfully. The honest rendering of its smallness is the feature, not a bug.
postImplementationRePins_partF.F7_performance: LOW-MEDIUM — the poller is O(subjects) per run, bounded by the Operator's cadence; bun:sqlite indexing is trivial; the JSONL chain is append-only and cheap to verify. The real new maintenance tax is the pinned contract versions (RP-5) — an Aave/Sky/Ethena upgrade requires a disclosed re-pin. That is correct: the moat's trustworthiness is worth a re-pin per upgrade.
postImplementationRePins_partF.F8_cannotAnswer: realLineageCount 0. ownCaptures 0 until the Operator runs the verb. V42 makes the record un-foolable and lays the first REAL★ stone — but the stone is length-0 until a human runs capture, and the second manifest is still unwritten. The capture verb is the closest thing to an on-ramp the instrument has ever had — it pays from the first real run — but the agent cannot take the first run for him (AGENT-tier, quarantined). The door is still his to open.
